title: Von Braun encourages Mitchell's consciousness research

tellings.quote: He was, according to Mitchell, deeply supportive, even encouraging Mitchell to find a site within NASA to study consciousness further.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, told a story he got from Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who later founded the Institute of Noetic Sciences, a group that studies the human mind and consciousness. According to Mitchell, in the 1970s the famous rocket engineer Wernher von Braun was deeply supportive of this research and even urged Mitchell to find a place inside NASA, the US space agency, to study consciousness further. That would mean a leading figure of the space program took the study of the mind seriously.
